note: Captured from the CHR test router. The two static entries were created FOR the capture, with documentation-range addresses (TEST-NET-2, RFC 5737) and locally administered MACs, and removed after it; the one dynamic row is QEMU user networking's own gateway (10.0.2.2 and QEMU's fixed MAC), a constant of the emulator rather than a network. What is real is the router's own reply: which fields /ip/arp returns and how it spells the dynamic, complete and published flags. tools/capture-fixtures.js drives the Node collectors and cannot capture an area, so this was read through /ip/arp/print and written in the same shape.
